admission.justification: Realized in server.py, which narrows after registration, and in read_only.py, whose marks run over the whole surface first; tests check the per-role order, the surviving marks and the refusal of an unclassified excluded tool.

applicability: agents-remember-task servers that create_server builds with a readable role binding.
conditions: The binding names a canonical role or the system-specialist alias.
exclusions: Unbound and explainer-only servers, which keep the whole registered roster.
Tool schemas and descriptions, which the narrowing does not change.
statement: A role-bound agents-remember-task server registers and read-only-classifies every tool first, then removes every registered tool outside the role's allowlist, keeping the survivors' PUBLIC_TOOLS order, schemas and annotations.
